summary: Switch penalty 2.0 was +46 on 2025/26 and was not the arm sent to the holdout. On 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25 it scored −128, −79, and −156 against the default penalty of 1.0. Hits fell and blank starters after substitutes rose in each of those seasons. The out-of-sample sum is −363. The default stays 1.0.
